title: Internship Offers

examples.explanation: Accept the 30 offer on day 1 and the 50 offer on day 2. Only two offers can be accepted by day 2, and 30 + 50 is the best pair.
All three deadlines are day 3, so all three fit.

hints: Suppose you already know which offers to accept. In what order should you accept them so no deadline is missed?
A set of offers is possible exactly when, for every day d, at most d chosen offers have a deadline of d or earlier.
Go through offers by deadline. Keep the chosen ones in a min-heap of stipends. If the heap holds more offers than the current deadline allows, drop the smallest.
